summary: The application was presented to the Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee (PDAC) on 29 March 2016, which voted 12 to 2 that the benefits of pimavanserin outweighed its risks, endorsing approval. The available review documents (SumR, RiskR) only report the vote outcome; the MedR and RiskR were written before the meeting and describe the safety concerns (increased morbidity/mortality signal, pulmonary phospholipidosis) as FDA-reviewer/internal concerns rather than committee-raised ones. No review document ties a specific committee-raised concern to a resulting change in the approval, so no linkages are asserted; the Boxed Warning for increased mortality in dementia-related psychosis is described as class-standard antipsychotic labeling driven by FDA review, not attributed to the AdComm.
